041/**
042 * Runs one tool under a pseudo-terminal through {@code juneau_terminal.py --pty} and exposes its output as a
043 * {@link FileTerminalSource} and its steps as a {@link FileTerminalViewSource}.
044 *
045 * <p>
046 * The command line is
047 * {@code python3 <script> --console none --pty --size <cols>x<rows> --full-log <log> --events <events> <tool> -- <cmd...>},
048 * with the log ({@value #LOG_NAME}), its {@code .size} sidecar and the events file ({@value #EVENTS_NAME}) in the
049 * given run directory.  The script is found through the system property {@value #SCRIPT_PROPERTY}, then the
050 * environment variable {@value #SCRIPT_ENV}.
051 *
052 * <p>
053 * The run directory is single-use.  The tool's working directory is the {@code work} subdirectory of it, so the log is not in the tool's working directory; the directory is limited to its owner where the file system allows. The runner's own stdout and stderr
054 * go to {@code runner.out} there, in append mode and uncapped; that file is diagnostic only.
055 *
056 * <p>
057 * Both sources share one done flag, set once the process has exited.  If the runner exits without writing a
058 * {@code done} event, a warning {@code note} and {@code done {status:"fail"}} are appended first.  Only the last
059 * {@value #TAIL_BYTES} bytes of the events file are scanned for that {@code done} event, because the protocol puts it
060 * last.
061 *
062 * <p>
063 * The exit hook runs on one daemon thread per process, named {@code juneau-terminal-exit-<pid>}.  Its executor is
064 * shut down once the hook has run, and {@link #close()} waits for that.
065 *
066 * <p>
067 * Started with input on, the runner also gets {@code --input stdin} (right after the events pair) and the process is a
068 * {@link TerminalSink}: {@link #write(byte[])} queues the bytes in a {@value #INPUT_LIMIT}-byte pending buffer and never
069 * blocks, and one daemon thread per process, named {@code juneau-terminal-input-<pid>}, copies them to the runner's
070 * stdin, flushing after each chunk.  A closed or broken pipe turns {@link #acceptsInput()} false and discards the
071 * buffer.  With input off the command line and the streams are exactly as above, no writer thread starts, and
072 * {@link #acceptsInput()} is always false.
073 *
074 * <p>
075 * Started with a {@link TerminalPrompts}, the runner gets {@code --prompts stdio} and its stdout and stdin become the
076 * prompt channel: one daemon thread per process, named {@code terminal-prompts-<dir name>}, reads the stdout lines (at
077 * most {@value #PROMPT_LINE_LIMIT} bytes each; a longer one is dropped) and hands them to
078 * {@link TerminalPrompts#onLine(String)}, then calls {@link TerminalPrompts#onEnd()} once.  The runner's stderr goes to
079 * {@code runner.out}.  {@link #answer(String)} writes one line back.  Neither a prompt line nor an answer is ever
080 * logged.  Input and prompts are mutually exclusive.
081 *
082 * <p>
083 * POSIX only: there is no Windows pseudo-terminal support.
084 *
085 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
086 * <p class='bjava'>
087 *    TerminalProcess <jv>p</jv> = TerminalProcess.<jsm>start</jsm>(<js>"maven"</js>, List.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"mvn"</js>, <js>"test"</js>), 120, 40, <jv>runDir</jv>);
088 *    <jv>terminals</jv>.put(<jv>id</jv>, <jv>p</jv>.terminal());
089 *    <jv>terminalViews</jv>.put(<jv>id</jv>, <jv>p</jv>.events());
090 * </p>
091 */
092@SuppressWarnings({
093   "java:S3776" // Start-up validation and shutdown are linear sequences of independent steps.
094})
095public final class TerminalProcess implements AutoCloseable, TerminalSink {
096
097   /** The system property naming {@code juneau_terminal.py}. */
098   public static final String SCRIPT_PROPERTY = "juneau.terminal.script";
099
100   /** The environment variable naming {@code juneau_terminal.py}, read when the property is not set. */
101   public static final String SCRIPT_ENV = "JUNEAU_TERMINAL_SCRIPT";
102
103   /** The byte log's file name in the run directory. */
104   public static final String LOG_NAME = "terminal.log";
105
106   /** The events file's name in the run directory. */
107   public static final String EVENTS_NAME = "terminal.events.jsonl";
108
109   /** The tool's working directory, a subdirectory of the run directory. */
110   static final String WORK_DIR = "work";
111
112   /** How much of the end of the events file is scanned for a {@code done} event. */
113   static final int TAIL_BYTES = 64 * 1024;
114
115   /** How long {@link #close()} waits for the exit hook. */
116   static final int CLOSE_WAIT_SECONDS = 5;
117
118   /** The most input bytes waiting for the writer thread: queued bytes only, not the chunk being written. */
119   static final int INPUT_LIMIT = 64 * 1024;
120
121   /** The longest prompt line read from the runner, in bytes. */
122   static final int PROMPT_LINE_LIMIT = 1 << 20;
123
124   /** How long {@link #close()} lets a prompt-channel runner end by itself after its stdin closes, in milliseconds. */
125   static final int PROMPTS_CLOSE_GRACE_MS = 3000;
126
127   /** How long {@link #close()} waits for the prompt reader thread, in milliseconds. */
128   static final int PROMPTS_JOIN_MILLIS = 2000;
129
130   /** How often the nudge thread checks the log size, in milliseconds. */
131   static final int NUDGE_POLL_MILLIS = 100;
132
133   /** How long {@link #close()} waits for the nudge thread, in milliseconds. */
134   static final int NUDGE_JOIN_MILLIS = 1000;
135
136   /** How long {@link #close()} waits for the input writer thread, in milliseconds. */
137   static final int WRITER_JOIN_MILLIS = 1000;
138
139   private static final Set<String> TOOLS = Set.of("maven", "pytest", "playwright", "generic");
140   private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(TerminalProcess.class.getName());

142   /** What the launcher reads from its environment; replaced in tests. */
143   record Host(String osName, String scriptProperty, String scriptEnv, String path) {
144      static Host system() {
145         return new Host(System.getProperty("os.name", ""), System.getProperty(SCRIPT_PROPERTY), System.getenv(SCRIPT_ENV), System.getenv("PATH"));
146      }
147   }
148
149   private final Process process;
150   private final Path logFile;
151   private final Path events;
152   private final Path runDir;
153   private final AtomicBoolean done = new AtomicBoolean();
154   private final FileTerminalSource terminal;
155   private final FileTerminalViewSource terminalView;
156   private final ExecutorService executor;
157   private final CompletableFuture<Integer> exit;
158   private final AtomicReference<Thread> exitThread = new AtomicReference<>();
159
160   // Input mode.  pending, pendingBytes, writing, inputFailed and closed are guarded by inLock.
161   private final boolean input;
162   private final Object inLock = new Object();
163   private final ArrayDeque<byte[]> pending = new ArrayDeque<>();
164   private int pendingBytes;  // Queued bytes only; a chunk leaves the count when the writer takes it, before it is written.
165   private boolean writing;
166   private boolean inputFailed;
167   private boolean closed;
168   private final Thread writer;
169
170   // Prompt channel.  answerLock serializes answers; answersClosed is set once the channel can take no more.
171   private final TerminalPrompts prompts;
172   private final ReentrantLock answerLock = new ReentrantLock();
173   private volatile boolean answersClosed;
174   private final Thread promptThread;
175
176   // Nudges.  nudgeThread, nudgeSet and nudgeClosed are guarded by nudgeLock.
177   private final Object nudgeLock = new Object();
178   private Thread nudgeThread;
179   private boolean nudgeSet;
180   private boolean nudgeClosed;
181   private volatile boolean nudgeStop;
182
183   /** Appends the missing done event; replaced in tests. */
184   @FunctionalInterface
185   interface DoneWriter {
186      void ensureDone(Path events, int exitCode) throws IOException;
187   }
188
189   private TerminalProcess(Process process, Path log, Path events, DoneWriter doneWriter, boolean input, TerminalPrompts prompts, Path runDir) {
190      this.runDir = runDir;
191      this.process = process;
192      this.input = input;
193      this.prompts = prompts;
194      this.logFile = log;
195      this.events = events;
196      terminal = FileTerminalSource.create(log).terminal(done::get).build();
197      terminalView = FileTerminalViewSource.create(events).terminal(done::get).build();
198      executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(r -> {
199         var t = new Thread(r, "juneau-terminal-exit-" + process.pid());
200         t.setDaemon(true);
201         return t;
202      });
203      exit = process.onExit().thenApplyAsync(p -> {
204         exitThread.set(Thread.currentThread());
205         try {
206            doneWriter.ensureDone(events, p.exitValue());
207         } catch (Exception e) {
208            LOG.log(Level.WARNING, e, () -> "Could not append the done event to '" + events + "'.");
209         } finally {
210            done.set(true);
211            executor.shutdown();
212         }
213         return p.exitValue();
214      }, executor);
215      if (input) {
216         // Every field the writer thread and the onExit callback read is assigned above; keep that order.
217         writer = new Thread(this::pump, "juneau-terminal-input-" + process.pid());
218         writer.setDaemon(true);
219         process.onExit().thenRun(() -> {
220            synchronized (inLock) {
221               inLock.notifyAll();
222            }
223         });
224         writer.start();
225      } else {
226         writer = null;
227      }
228      if (prompts != null) {
229         promptThread = new Thread(this::readPrompts, "terminal-prompts-" + id());
230         promptThread.setDaemon(true);
231         promptThread.start();
232      } else {
233         promptThread = null;
234      }
235   }
236
237   /** The prompt reader thread: hands each stdout line to the prompts, then reports the end exactly once. */
238   private void readPrompts() {
239      try (var in = new BufferedInputStream(process.getInputStream())) {
240         var line = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
241         var over = false;
242         for (var b = in.read(); b >= 0; b = in.read()) {
243            if (b == '\n') {
244               if (over)
245                  LOG.log(Level.WARNING, "prompt line over limit dropped");
246               else
247                  prompts.onLine(line.toString(UTF_8));
248               line.reset();
249               over = false;
250            } else if (! over) {
251               if (line.size() >= PROMPT_LINE_LIMIT) {
252                  over = true;
253                  line.reset();
254               } else {
255                  line.write(b);
256               }
257            }
258         }
259      } catch (IOException e) {
260         // A closed pipe ends the channel; the exception text could hold a prompt, so it is not logged.
261         LOG.log(Level.FINE, () -> "TerminalProcess prompt channel closed for '" + events + "'.");
262      } finally {
263         answersClosed = true;
264         prompts.onEnd();
265      }
266   }
267
268   /** The writer thread: copies pending chunks to stdin, never holding {@link #inLock} while writing. */
269   @SuppressWarnings({
270      "java:S3626" // The early return is what ends the endless writer loop after a failed write.
271   })
272   private void pump() {
273      var out = process.getOutputStream();
274      try {
275         while (true) {
276            byte[] chunk;
277            synchronized (inLock) {
278               while (pending.isEmpty() && ! closed && process.isAlive())
279                  inLock.wait();
280               if (closed || pending.isEmpty())
281                  return;
282               chunk = pending.poll();
283               pendingBytes -= chunk.length;
284               writing = true;
285            }
286            if (! writeChunk(out, chunk))
287               return;
288         }
289      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
290         Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
291      } finally {
292         closeQuietly(out);
293      }
294   }
295
296   // Writes one chunk to stdin; false once the pipe has failed and the pending input has been dropped.
297   private boolean writeChunk(OutputStream out, byte[] chunk) {
298      try {
299         out.write(chunk);
300         out.flush();
301         return true;
302      } catch (IOException e) {
303         synchronized (inLock) {
304            inputFailed = true;
305            pending.clear();
306            pendingBytes = 0;
307         }
308         LOG.log(Level.FINE, e, () -> "TerminalProcess input pipe failed for '" + events + "'.");
309         return false;
310      } finally {
311         synchronized (inLock) {
312            writing = false;
313         }
314      }
315   }
316
317   private static void closeQuietly(OutputStream out) {
318      try {
319         out.close();
320      } catch (IOException e) {
321         // A broken pipe has nothing left to close.
322      }
323   }

325   /**
326    * Starts a tool under a pseudo-terminal.
327    *
328    * @param tool The juneau_terminal tool parser: {@code maven}, {@code pytest}, {@code playwright} or {@code generic}.
329    * @param cmd The command and its arguments; at least one element.
330    *    It is a token list: each element reaches the tool as one argument, through {@link ProcessBuilder}.  It is never
331    *    joined into a string or given to a shell, so shell metacharacters in an element are literal.
332    * @param cols The terminal width, 1-9999.
333    * @param rows The terminal height, 1-9999.
334    * @param root The configured root directory for runs; created if missing.  The process creates and owns a new run
335    *    directory under it (mode 700, named by a generated id); callers never choose that path.  The tool works in a
336    *    {@code work} subdirectory of the run directory, and the runner's own stdout and stderr go to
337    *    {@code runner.out} in the run directory, in append mode and uncapped; that file is diagnostic only.
338    *    See {@link #runDir()} and {@link #id()}.
339    * @return The running process.
340    * @throws IOException If the directory could not be prepared or the process could not start.
341    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If an argument is out of range.
342    * @throws IllegalStateException If the script is not configured or {@code python3} is not on the {@code PATH}.
343    * @throws UnsupportedOperationException On Windows.
344    */
345   public static TerminalProcess start(String tool, List<String> cmd, int cols, int rows, Path root) throws IOException {
346      return start(tool, cmd, cols, rows, root, false);
347   }
348

350    * Starts a tool under a pseudo-terminal, optionally with input.

355    *
356    * @param tool The juneau_terminal tool parser.
357    * @param cmd The command and its arguments; at least one element.
358    * @param cols The terminal width, 1-9999.
359    * @param rows The terminal height, 1-9999.
360    * @param root The run root; see {@link #start(String, List, int, int, Path)}.
361    * @param input Whether the job takes input through {@link #write(byte[])}.
362    * @return The running process.
363    * @throws IOException If the directory could not be prepared or the process could not start.
364    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If an argument is out of range.
365    * @throws IllegalStateException If the script is not configured or {@code python3} is not on the {@code PATH}.
366    * @throws UnsupportedOperationException On Windows.
367    */
368   public static TerminalProcess start(String tool, List<String> cmd, int cols, int rows, Path root, boolean input) throws IOException {
369      return start(tool, cmd, cols, rows, root, Host.system(), input);
370   }

379    * @param tool The juneau_terminal tool parser.

381    * @param cols The terminal width, 1-9999.
382    * @param rows The terminal height, 1-9999.
383    * @param root The run root; see {@link #start(String, List, int, int, Path)}.
384    * @param prompts Receives the prompt lines; not <jk>null</jk>.
385    * @return The running process.
386    * @throws IOException If the directory could not be prepared or the process could not start.
387    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If an argument is out of range.
388    * @throws IllegalStateException If the script is not configured or {@code python3} is not on the {@code PATH}.
389    * @throws UnsupportedOperationException On Windows.
390    */
391   public static TerminalProcess start(String tool, List<String> cmd, int cols, int rows, Path root, TerminalPrompts prompts) throws IOException {
392      Objects.requireNonNull(prompts, "prompts");
393      return start(tool, cmd, cols, rows, root, Host.system(), TerminalProcess::ensureDone, false, prompts);
394   }

452   @SuppressWarnings({
453      "java:S107" // internal entry point; the parameters are the process configuration
454   })
455   static TerminalProcess start(String tool, List<String> cmd, int cols, int rows, Path root, Host host, DoneWriter doneWriter, boolean input, TerminalPrompts prompts, Map<String,String> env) throws IOException {
456      if (input && prompts != null)
457         throw new IllegalArgumentException("input and prompts are mutually exclusive");
458      if (host.osName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith("windows"))
459         throw new UnsupportedOperationException("TerminalProcess needs a POSIX pseudo-terminal; Windows is not supported.");
460      if (! TOOLS.contains(tool))
461         throw iaex("TerminalProcess tool must be one of %s; got '%s'.", new TreeSet<>(TOOLS), tool);
462      if (ie(cmd))
463         throw iaex("TerminalProcess cmd must have at least one element.");
464      if (cols < 1 || cols > 9999 || rows < 1 || rows > 9999)
465         throw iaex("TerminalProcess size must be 1-9999 x 1-9999; got '%sx%s'.", cols, rows);
466      var script = host.scriptProperty() != null && ! host.scriptProperty().isBlank() ? host.scriptProperty() : host.scriptEnv();
467      if (ib(script))
468         throw new IllegalStateException("TerminalProcess cannot find juneau_terminal.py: set the system property " + SCRIPT_PROPERTY + " or the environment variable " + SCRIPT_ENV + ".");
469      var python = findOnPath("python3", host.path());
470      if (python == null)
471         throw new IllegalStateException("TerminalProcess cannot find python3 on the PATH.");
472      var dir = newRunDir(root);
473      // The tool works in its own subdirectory, so the log, events and size files sit outside its working directory.
474      var work = dir.resolve(WORK_DIR);
475      Files.createDirectories(work);
476      restrictToOwner(work);
477      var log = dir.resolve(LOG_NAME);
478      var events = dir.resolve(EVENTS_NAME);
479      // Written here as well as by juneau_terminal, so a request that arrives before the child starts sees the real size.
480      Files.writeString(log.resolveSibling(LOG_NAME + ".size"), "{\"cols\":" + cols + ",\"rows\":" + rows + "}");
481      var argv = new ArrayList<String>();
482      argv.addAll(List.of(python.toString(), script, "--console", "none", "--pty", "--size", cols + "x" + rows,
483         "--full-log", log.toString(), "--events", events.toString()));
484      if (input)
485         argv.addAll(List.of("--input", "stdin"));
486      if (prompts != null)
487         argv.addAll(List.of("--prompts", "stdio"));
488      argv.addAll(List.of(tool, "--"));
489      argv.addAll(cmd);
490      var runnerOut = ProcessBuilder.Redirect.appendTo(dir.resolve("runner.out").toFile());
491      var pb = new ProcessBuilder(argv).directory(work.toFile());
492      pb.environment().putAll(env);
493      if (prompts == null)
494         pb.redirectErrorStream(true).redirectOutput(runnerOut);
495      else
496         pb.redirectError(runnerOut);  // stdout stays a pipe: it is the prompt channel.
497      return new TerminalProcess(pb.start(), log, events, doneWriter, input, prompts, dir);
498   }
499
500   /** Creates a new, empty run directory under the root, readable only by its owner; the name is generated. */
501   private static Path newRunDir(Path root) throws IOException {
502      Files.createDirectories(root);
503      try {
504         return Files.createTempDirectory(root, "run-", PosixFilePermissions.asFileAttribute(PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rwx------")));
505      } catch (UnsupportedOperationException e) {
506         LOG.log(Level.FINE, e, () -> "No POSIX permissions for '" + root + "'.");
507         return Files.createTempDirectory(root, "run-");
508      }
509   }
510
511   /** Limits a run directory to its owner (mode 700) where the file system supports POSIX permissions. */
512   private static void restrictToOwner(Path d) throws IOException {
513      try {
514         Files.setPosixFilePermissions(d, PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rwx------"));
515      } catch (UnsupportedOperationException e) {
516         LOG.log(Level.FINE, e, () -> "No POSIX permissions for '" + d + "'.");
517      }
518   }
519
520   /** Returns the first executable {@code name} in the {@code PATH} directories, or <jk>null</jk>. */
521   static Path findOnPath(String name, String path) {
522      if (path == null)
523         return null;
524      for (var d : path.split(File.pathSeparator)) {
525         if (d.isEmpty())
526            continue;
527         var p = Paths.get(d, name);
528         if (Files.isRegularFile(p) && Files.isExecutable(p))
529            return p;
530      }
531      return null;
532   }
533
534   /** Appends a warning note and a failing done event when the last {@value #TAIL_BYTES} bytes of the events file hold no done event. */
535   static void ensureDone(Path events, int exitCode) throws IOException {
536      var text = "";
537      if (Files.exists(events)) {
538         try (var ch = FileChannel.open(events, StandardOpenOption.READ, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
539            var from = Math.max(0, ch.size() - TAIL_BYTES);
540            var buf = ByteBuffer.allocate((int)(ch.size() - from));
541            while (buf.hasRemaining() && ch.read(buf, from + buf.position()) >= 0) {
542               // The condition does the reading; the loop has no body.
543            }
544            text = new String(buf.array(), 0, buf.position(), UTF_8);
545         }
546      }
547      // A fragment at the start of the tail never parses, so it is never taken for a done event.
548      for (var line : text.split("\n")) {
549         if (isDone(line))
550            return;
551      }
552      var sb = new StringBuilder();
553      if (! text.isEmpty() && ! text.endsWith("\n"))
554         sb.append('\n');
555      sb.append(JsonSerializer.DEFAULT.toString(TerminalEvent.note(TerminalEvent.Level.WARN, "runner exited without done, exit " + exitCode).toContractMap())).append('\n');
556      sb.append(JsonSerializer.DEFAULT.toString(TerminalEvent.done(TerminalEvent.DoneStatus.FAIL).toContractMap())).append('\n');
557      Files.writeString(events, sb, UTF_8, CREATE, APPEND);
558   }
559
560   private static boolean isDone(String line) {
561      if (line.isBlank())
562         return false;
563      try {
564         return TerminalEvent.fromMap(Json.to(line, Map.class)).kind() == TerminalEvent.Kind.DONE;
565      } catch (Exception e) {
566         return false;
567      }
568   }

633   /**
634    * Waits for the process to exit and for the done event to be in place.
635    *
636    * @param timeout The longest wait.
637    * @param unit The unit of {@code timeout}.
638    * @return The runner's exit code.
639    * @throws InterruptedException If interrupted.
640    * @throws TimeoutException If the process is still running.
641    */

643      try {
644         return exit.get(timeout, unit);

650   /**
651    * Whether input is accepted right now.
652    *
653    * @return <jk>true</jk> only when input is on, the process is alive, no write has failed and the process has not been
654    *    closed.
655    */
656   @Override /* TerminalSink */
657   public boolean acceptsInput() {
658      synchronized (inLock) {
659         // HTT: close() waits for the process to exit, so isAlive() is already false afterwards.  The closed term
660         // guards the window inside close(); it is not observable without a test seam.
661         return input && ! closed && ! inputFailed && process.isAlive();
662      }
663   }
664
665   /**
666    * Queues the bytes for the runner's stdin; never blocks.
667    *
668    * @param bytes The bytes to send; copied.
669    * @return <jk>false</jk> when input is not accepted, or when the bytes do not fit in the {@value #INPUT_LIMIT}-byte
670    *    pending buffer.  An empty array returns {@link #acceptsInput()}.
671    */
672   @Override /* TerminalSink */
673   public boolean write(byte[] bytes) {
674      synchronized (inLock) {
675         if (! acceptsInput())
676            return false;
677         if (bytes.length == 0)
678            return true;
679         if (pendingBytes + bytes.length > INPUT_LIMIT)
680            return false;
681         pending.add(bytes.clone());
682         pendingBytes += bytes.length;
683         inLock.notifyAll();
684         return true;
685      }
686   }
687
688   /**
689    * Whether an answer can be sent right now.
690    *
691    * @return <jk>true</jk> only when a prompt channel is on, the process is alive and the channel has not ended or failed.
692    */
693   public boolean acceptsAnswers() {
694      return prompts != null && ! answersClosed && process.isAlive();
695   }
696
697   /**
698    * Writes one answer line to the script's prompt channel; never blocks behind another answer and never logs the line.
699    *
700    * @param jsonLine The answer as one JSON line, without a newline.
701    * @return <jk>false</jk> when there is no channel, it has ended, the line holds a newline, another answer is being
702    *    written, or the write failed.
703    */
704   public boolean answer(String jsonLine) {
705      if (jsonLine.indexOf('\n') >= 0 || ! acceptsAnswers() || ! answerLock.tryLock())
706         return false;
707      try {
708         var out = process.getOutputStream();
709         out.write((jsonLine + "\n").getBytes(UTF_8));
710         out.flush();
711         return true;
712      } catch (IOException e) {
713         answersClosed = true;
714         return false;
715      } finally {
716         answerLock.unlock();
717      }
718   }

720   /**
721    * Polls the log's size every 100 ms and reports growth, then a final done, to a publisher.
722    *
723    * <p>
724    * The runner writes the log in another process, so there is no in-process append hook to use.  The publisher runs on
725    * a daemon thread named {@code juneau-terminal-nudge-<pid>}; a {@link RuntimeException} it throws is logged at
726    * {@code FINE} and otherwise ignored.  The thread ends after the done report, or when {@link #close()} is called.
727    *
728    * @param terminalId The terminal id passed to the publisher; must be a valid run id.
729    * @param publisher The publisher.
730    * @return This object.
731    * @throws NullPointerException If an argument is <jk>null</jk>.
732    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the id is not a valid run id.
733    * @throws IllegalStateException If a publisher is already set, or this process has been closed.
734    */
735   public TerminalProcess nudges(String terminalId, TerminalNudgePublisher publisher) {
736      Objects.requireNonNull(terminalId, "terminalId");
737      Objects.requireNonNull(publisher, "publisher");
738      if (! isRunId(terminalId))
739         throw iaex("TerminalProcess nudge id is not a valid run id: '%s'.", terminalId);
740      synchronized (nudgeLock) {
741         if (nudgeClosed)
742            throw new IllegalStateException("TerminalProcess is closed.");
743         if (nudgeSet)
744            throw new IllegalStateException("TerminalProcess nudges are already set.");
745         nudgeSet = true;
746         nudgeThread = new Thread(() -> watch(terminalId, publisher), "juneau-terminal-nudge-" + process.pid());
747         nudgeThread.setDaemon(true);
748         nudgeThread.start();
749      }
750      return this;
751   }
752
753   /** The nudge thread: reports log growth until the process is done or the thread is stopped. */
754   private void watch(String id, TerminalNudgePublisher publisher) {
755      var last = -1L;
756      while (! nudgeStop) {
757         var fin = isDone();
758         var size = sizeOrZero(logFile);
759         if (size > last || fin) {
760            try {
761               publisher.nudge(id, size, fin);
762            } catch (RuntimeException e) {
763               LOG.log(Level.FINE, e, () -> "Terminal nudge publisher failed for '" + id + "'.");
764            }
765            last = size;
766         }
767         if (fin)
768            return;
769         try {
770            Thread.sleep(NUDGE_POLL_MILLIS);
771         } catch (InterruptedException e) {
772            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
773            return;
774         }
775      }
776   }
777
778   private static long sizeOrZero(Path p) {
779      try {
780         return Files.size(p);
781      } catch (IOException e) {
782         return 0;
783      }
784   }

796   /**
797    * Asks the runner to stop and waits for it, killing it if it does not.
798    *
799    * <p>
800    * Sends SIGTERM to the runner, which passes it to the tool so that the tool can clean up and record that it was
801    * cancelled.  If the process is still running after {@code grace}, this falls back to {@link #close()}, which kills it.
802    * It does nothing when the process has already exited, and it is safe to call more than once.
803    * Call {@link #close()} afterwards as usual to release the process's resources.
804    *
805    * @param grace How long to wait for the process to exit after SIGTERM; not <jk>null</jk>, zero or negative kills at once.
806    */
807   public void terminate(Duration grace) {
808      Objects.requireNonNull(grace, "grace");
809      if (! process.isAlive())
810         return;
811      process.destroy();
812      try {
813         if (process.waitFor(Math.max(0, grace.toMillis()), TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS))
814            return;
815      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
816         Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
817      }
818      close();
819   }
820
821   /**
822    * Kills the runner and its tool if they are still running, then waits up to {@value #CLOSE_WAIT_SECONDS} seconds for
823    * the exit hook.
824    *
825    * <p>
826    * The hook writes the done event and shuts its executor down, so once this returns normally both have happened.  The
827    * executor is not shut down here: a hook submitted after that would be refused, and the done flag would never be set.
828    *
829    * <p>
830    * With input on, it first stops input: pending bytes are dropped, stdin is closed and the writer thread is told to
831    * stop.  If the writer thread is blocked writing to a full pipe, it closes stdin itself once the kill breaks the pipe.
832    * Afterwards this waits up to {@value #WRITER_JOIN_MILLIS} ms for the writer thread.  The nudge thread, if any, is
833    * stopped first of all and joined for up to {@value #NUDGE_JOIN_MILLIS} ms.  With input off, it only kills.
834    */
835   @Override /* AutoCloseable */
836   public void close() {
837      Thread nudger;
838      synchronized (nudgeLock) {
839         nudgeClosed = true;
840         nudgeStop = true;
841         nudger = nudgeThread;
842      }
843      if (nudger != null)
844         nudger.interrupt();
845      if (prompts != null) {
846         // Closing stdin tells the runner the host is gone; it ends the job and writes done itself.
847         answersClosed = true;
848         closeQuietly(process.getOutputStream());
849         try {
850            process.waitFor(PROMPTS_CLOSE_GRACE_MS, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
851         } catch (InterruptedException e) {
852            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
853         }
854      }
855      if (input) {
856         synchronized (inLock) {
857            closed = true;
858            pending.clear();
859            pendingBytes = 0;
860            inLock.notifyAll();
861            // Closing flushes the stream, which waits for a write in progress; the writer flushes after every chunk, so
862            // with no write in progress there is nothing to flush and this cannot block.
863            if (! writing)
864               closeQuietly(process.getOutputStream());
865         }
866      }
867      process.descendants().forEach(ProcessHandle::destroyForcibly);
868      process.destroyForcibly();
869      try {
870         exit.get(CLOSE_WAIT_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
871      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
872         Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
873      } catch (ExecutionException | TimeoutException e) {
874         LOG.log(Level.WARNING, e, () -> "TerminalProcess exit hook did not finish for '" + events + "'.");
875      }
876      if (nudger != null) {
877         try {
878            nudger.join(NUDGE_JOIN_MILLIS);
879         } catch (InterruptedException e) {
880            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
881         }
882         if (nudger.isAlive())
883            LOG.log(Level.WARNING, () -> "TerminalProcess nudge thread did not stop for '" + events + "'.");
884      }
885      if (promptThread != null) {
886         try {
887            promptThread.join(PROMPTS_JOIN_MILLIS);
888         } catch (InterruptedException e) {
889            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
890         }
891         if (promptThread.isAlive())
892            LOG.log(Level.WARNING, () -> "TerminalProcess prompt thread did not stop for '" + events + "'.");
893      }
894      if (writer != null) {
895         try {
896            writer.join(WRITER_JOIN_MILLIS);
897         } catch (InterruptedException e) {
898            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
899         }
900         if (writer.isAlive())
901            LOG.log(Level.WARNING, () -> "TerminalProcess input writer thread did not stop for '" + events + "'.");
902      }
903   }
